characters.earlierSummary: Johann Schmidt, the Red Skull, is Hydra's leader, enhanced by an early super-soldier serum with great strength, speed, stamina, reflexes and intellect. He fights with a Tesseract-powered Luger-style handgun and studied mythical artifacts as science. After the Tesseract transported him to Vormir he became the Soul Stone's Stonekeeper.

characters.summary: Rocket is an engineered raccoon tactical genius, master marksman, and expert engineer who builds devastating heavy weaponry and traps from scrap and advanced tech.

Ship ramming (crashed the Warbird into the Dark Aster)

characters.earlierSummary: Rocket is a raccoon enhanced by the High Evolutionary's experiments with intelligence and speech. He is an engineer who builds weapons and traps from scrap, an expert marksman and a skilled pilot of the Milano, Warbird and other ships.

characters.summary: Ronan the Accuser is a radical Kree zealot endowed with immense physical strength and durability, wielding the Universal Weapon hammer and briefly harnessing the Power Stone.

techniques: Concussive force blasts from the Universal Weapon

mechanisms: Superhuman Kree durability (shrugged off Drax's punches)
Kree armor that boosts strength and durability (withstood a Hadron Enforcer blast)

weaknesses: Overconfidence in religious zealotry and vulnerability to energy feedback if overwhelmed by raw infinity stone power
Once the Power Stone left his control, the Guardians turned its energy against him

depictions.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe (Earth-616): Guardians of the Galaxy, Captain Marvel

limitations: Vulnerable to direct cooperative handling of Infinity Stone energy by multiple beings
His Stone-level power depended on the Power Stone embedded in the Universal Weapon.

sources.supports: Ronan the Accuser background as Kree radical, use of Universal Weapon, and integration of the Power Stone in Guardians of the Galaxy

Strength and durability; Universal Weapon and Kree armor; killing the Other; merging the Power Stone into the Universal Weapon; beating Drax on Knowhere; destroying the Nova Corps fleet; death at the Guardians' hands; retreat from Captain Marvel; surviving the Hadron Enforcer.

characters.earlierSummary: Ronan the Accuser is a radical Kree warlord of great strength and durability who wields the Universal Weapon, a war hammer that fires concussive force. He embedded the Power Stone in it, destroying the Nova Corps fleet, before the Guardians turned the Stone against him.
